notes:
Added:
- 4 new UI languages: Chinese (中文), Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어) and Thai (ไทย) — the app now ships in 6 languages, with a new flag dropdown language picker (native-name labels) in the footer AND on the login screen
- Settings gear on the login screen: open app-wide Settings (auto-start, updates, dependencies, Kill All FFmpeg, ...) before signing in
- Homepage link (zenni-aio.viennv.dev) on the login screen
- Update checks now also work before signing in — the update banner can appear on the login screen

Changed:
- New account system: login now authenticates against the api.viennv.dev license server with a per-machine device identity; sessions are re-validated every 5 minutes, so account changes (lock, expiry, device limits) take effect within minutes instead of at next launch
- Signing out (or quitting the app) now ends the server session immediately, freeing the device slot for another machine
- Default language is now English (your saved language choice is kept)
- Login/session errors are shown as clear, translated messages (wrong password, account expired, device limit reached, ...) instead of raw codes
- Framework updated to Wails 2.13

Fixed:
- Accounts without an expiry date no longer show "Exp: 01/01/1970" — the expiry line is hidden instead
- Removed the stray gradient bar at the very top of the login screen
- Language button and Settings button on the login screen are now the same height
